messages:
Aisha: Heads-up — vendor NorthStar reported a QC backlog. Acceptance testing for SKU NS-RTX-8 delayed ~10 business days. This overlaps our Dedicated provisioning for EU-Dedicated-2 commit. Reassign or mitigation? @Liam @Jon
Liam: Ugh. Which reservations are affected and which customers are on the hook?
Aisha: Affected reservation:
```
reservation_id: RSRV-4821
sku: NS-RTX-8
commit: EU-Dedicated-2
units: 48
marketplace_flow: mp-onboard-2209
```
Aisha: 3 enterprise customers tied to that reservation (contracts flagged).
Jon: From logistics: a 10 business day delay likely pushes us past current manifest cutoff -> customs windows change. We can try swapping to alternate SKU NS-RTX-8L (lower perf) if SW compat is OK. Need SI signoff and marketplace listing change.
Maya: I can validate NS-RTX-8L driver compatibility. Quick check on staging should take ~3 days. If green, marketplace needs a version bump + config change. I can own validation.
Pat: Product POV: prefer avoiding breaking commitments. Proposal: temporarily route new Dedicated provisioning requests to hosted eu-west-2 capacity and offer a small billing credit for affected customers. Also prepare canary + rollback plan.
Liam: Agree. I'll open a capacity reallocation ticket and trigger a temporary burst policy. @deploy-bot can you apply the BP?
deploy-bot: update: burst policy request submitted: BP-749 -> awaiting infra approval.
Aisha: Also need marketplace & billing sync — UI should show ETA and potential SKU substitution. @Pat could you draft a short customer note?
Pat: On it. Draft will include: transparent ETA, option for SKU swap with equivalent SLAs, and credit if delay >14 days. Will share in #cs-digest.
Maya: Starting driver validation today. Tagging @Liam for test infra creds.
Liam: Sent test infra creds via DM. Also reducing live allocation on RSRV-4821 to 30 units and marking 18 units as pending substitution so we don't overcommit.
Aisha: Plan summary:
- Validate NS-RTX-8L (Maya) [ETA +3d]
- Reduce live allocation on RSRV-4821 to 30 (Liam) [in progress]
- Route new Dedicated provisions to hosted pool w/ surcharge & credit (Liam/Infra) [BP-749]
- Customer comms (Pat) [draft]
- Logistics follow-up with NorthStar for manifest (Jon)
Anyone object?
Jon: No objections. I'll kick off manifest follow-up and ask NorthStar for weekly status updates.
Maya: Validation = green on staging for driver tweak. No perf regressions on 99p latency. Pushed PR: https://git.redwood.ai/si/drivers/462
Aisha: Great, thanks. Reconvene in 24h for status update. :thumbsup:
